capture_path: a companion radio on USB, its PUSH_CODE_LOG_RX_DATA (0x88) event as recorded by the bench serial listener; request_snr_db and request_rssi_dbm are the listener's own report for the same event
note: rf_log_payload_hex is the 0x88 payload without its opcode byte: [SNR x4][RSSI][OTA packet]. Prepend 0x88 to get the notification exactly as the radio sent it.
